what: Moving placed areas or cells in World Painter is cumbersome. For paint cells: there's a 'move' tool that nudges selected cells one at a time via arrow buttons (up/down/left/right). For placed areas: you must unplace the area (click in area tool) then re-place it at the new cell. There's no drag-to-move for areas, and the move tool only works on paint layers, not placed areas/features.
why: User wants to easily reposition placed areas (like rooms in millwood__public_school scope) and painted cells. Current workflow requires multiple clicks and tool switches. The cell panel has a 'Move [area name]' button but it just switches to area tool - you still have to click the new cell.
how:
Two possible improvements:
1. For areas: Add drag-to-move in area tool - click and drag an already-placed area to a new cell (like moving a token).
2. For paint cells: The move tool already exists but only nudges 1 cell at a time via buttons. Could add drag-to-move for selected cells.
3. Consider a unified 'move' tool that works on both selected paint cells AND placed areas/features.
acceptance:
1. In area tool: click and drag an already-placed area to move it to a new cell (with visual feedback)
2. In move tool: drag selected cells to new position (not just nudge buttons)
3. Both operations are single undo steps
4. Visual preview during drag

browser_ui.home: World Painter editor (scopes with grid and placed areas)
steps: Open World Painter for millwood__public_school scope
Place an area on the grid (area tool)
Switch to move tool or stay in area tool
Click and drag the placed area to a new cell
Release - area moves to new cell in one undo step
browser_ui.reason: No drag-to-move for placed areas; move tool only nudges paint cells via buttons
browser_ui.alt_steps: Select paint cells with select tool, switch to move tool, drag selection to new position
